sections.title: The letter ele
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (ele) /ˈɛli/. Its main sound is heard in the word (lua) /ˈlu.ɐ/, which means moon. This letter makes two sounds.

sections.title: Making the sound
paragraphs: A consonant is a sound made when the mouth blocks or narrows the air. For the first sound, touch the ridge behind your upper teeth with your tongue tip. Air flows along the sides of the tongue. For the second sound, keep the tongue tip there and raise the back of your tongue. Touch your throat to feel your voice shake.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: This letter makes the sound in (lua) /ˈlu.ɐ/ before a vowel, as in (falar) /fɐˈlaɾ/. It makes a darker sound at the end of a syllable or word. You hear this darker sound in (sol) /sɔɫ/ and in (alto) /ˈaɫ.tu/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: At the end of a syllable, do not say a sound like w in low. Keep your tongue tip touching the ridge behind your upper teeth. Do not round your lips. Before a vowel, say it clearly like the l in light.
